question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The verse continues an enumeration of female figures begun in the preceding verse.
The listed figures are presented as alternatives or further members of the same group.
The comparative particle 'tathā' marks them as included in the same category of knowers.
inference: Additional types of women are enumerated as belonging among those who know through devotion.
uncertainties: The precise identity or referent of 'sararī' is unclear.
The precise identity or referent of 'gūlī' is unclear.
plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sarari-woman, or the guli-woman likewise.
